name: Lower trunk rotation
summary: Lying with knees bent, let the knees roll gently side to side while the shoulders stay flat.
setup: Lie on your back, knees bent and together, arms out to the sides. Let the knees fall slowly to one side as far as is comfortable, bring them back, then the other side.
why: The knees roll toward and away from a phone on the floor, and a phone overhead is impractical. Logged by hand.
tempo: Over 3 s, hold 2 s, back 3 s.
progression: Feet off the floor with the knees at 90°.
contraindications: Sharp back pain on the roll.

faults.label: Shoulder lifting
faults.tip: Roll only as far as both shoulders stay on the floor.

faults.label: Dropping the knees too far
faults.tip: Your range ends when the opposite shoulder starts to peel off the floor.

faults.label: Swinging the knees
faults.tip: Swinging uses momentum through the lower back — the opposite of what this drill is for.

faults.label: Knees separating
faults.tip: Keep the knees glued so both hips roll as one.
